posts.cooked:
This isn't quite fan fiction but my 11 yo was inspired by Sentinels of the Multiverse to make his own, custom LEGO Freedom Five minifigs. This was his first attempt at customizing. I thought I'd share them here.

First, Absolute Zero.

![](upload://nviIaVEhdwFfJXYZ55KjLndunSs.jpeg)

Next, Tachyon.

![](upload://bN7H0B89WCwvKK4xBInqvYD4MU.jpeg)

And then the Wraith.

![](upload://vMQnNDsVMyDLjZA03fHk9H9raAn.jpeg)

Followed by Legacy.

![](upload://pxAmrAd2JsZuKdhC8V0qD1AOOPK.jpeg)

Baron Blade, so they have someone to fight.

![](upload://hiaDzRcOMM2m2zPDUeEDjKCK8VD.jpeg)

And a group shot!

![](upload://haEr8zZvUppKOWqhBPaYJ9E6peJ.jpeg)
